description: This Java class 'CommandWrapper' encapsulates operation commands within the Fineract core project, handling various command actions related to entities such as loans, clients, and datatables. It provides factory methods for creating command instances, methods for checking command types and resource characteristics, and contains numerous fields representing command data.

classes.name: CommandWrapper
classes.description: A domain class representing command operations within Fineract, facilitating command creation, identification, and resource type checks, with various attributes to encapsulate command details.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Factory method to create a CommandWrapper instance with minimal parameters for a specific action on an entity.

methods.name: fromExistingCommand
methods.description: Factory methods to create a CommandWrapper instance from existing command identifiers and resource details, with overloads for different parameter sets.

methods.name: isCreate
methods.description: Checks if the command action is a creation operation.

methods.name: isCreateDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is creating a datatable resource without an entity ID.

methods.name: isDeleteDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is deleting a datatable resource without an entity ID.

methods.name: isUpdateDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command is updating a datatable resource without an entity ID.

methods.name: isDatatableResource
methods.description: Determines if the command targets a datatable resource.

methods.name: isDeleteOneToOne
methods.description: Checks if the command involves deleting a one-to-one resource relationship.

methods.name: isDeleteMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the command involves deleting multiple subresources.

methods.name: isUpdateOneToOne
methods.description: Checks if the command involves updating a one-to-one resource.

methods.name: isUpdateMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the command involves updating multiple subresources.

methods.name: isRegisterDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the command registers a new datatable resource.

methods.name: isNoteResource
methods.description: Checks if the command pertains to note-related resources.

methods.name: isChangeOfOwnUserDetails
methods.description: Determines if the command is a self-update or password change for the logged-in user.

methods.name: isUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the command action is an update operation and applicable for certain resource IDs.

methods.name: isCacheResource
methods.description: Checks if the command involves the 'CACHE' entity.

methods.name: isChangePasswordOperation
methods.description: Checks if the command is a password change operation.

methods.name: isUpdateOperation
methods.description: Checks if the command action indicates an update.

methods.name: isDelete
methods.description: Determines if the command is a delete operation on a resource.

methods.name: isDeleteOperation
methods.description: Checks if the command action is delete.

methods.name: isSurveyResource
methods.description: Checks if the command relates to survey resources.

methods.name: isRegisterSurvey
methods.description: Checks if the command action is register for a survey.

methods.name: isFullFilSurvey
methods.description: Checks if the command action is create (fulfill) for a survey.

methods.name: isWorkingDaysResource
methods.description: Checks if the command involves 'WORKINGDAYS' entity.

methods.name: isPasswordPreferencesResource
methods.description: Checks if the command involves password preferences entity.

methods.name: isInterestPauseResource
methods.description: Checks if the command involves 'INTEREST_PAUSE' entity.

methods.name: isInterestPauseCreateResource
methods.description: Checks if the command is creating an 'INTEREST_PAUSE'.

methods.name: isInterestPauseUpdateResource
methods.description: Checks if the command is updating an 'INTEREST_PAUSE'.

methods.name: isInterestPauseDeleteResource
methods.description: Checks if the command is deleting an 'INTEREST_PAUSE'.
